purpose: Stabilize Designer-specific Linux AT-SPI D-Bus and macOS NSAccessibility reader loops by re-querying current semantic nodes across tree rebuilds

local.python_validation: tests/designer_atspi_window_live_tests.py, tests/voiceover_designer_reader_loop.py, tests/atspi_orca_loop.py, tests/voiceover_loop.py and tests/platform_acceptance_tests.py compiled; git diff --check passed
local.linux_production_designer_atspi: passed selection, Unicode text edit, ThemeScope light -> dark, save and JSON readback under Xvfb/X11; provider=atspi-dbus; windowed=true
local.scope: Designer-specific reader loops re-query current semantic nodes for selection, property editing and Save after tree rebuilds; this remains protocol evidence and does not provide reader speech or manual desktop sign-off.

limitations: The hosted scripts do not provide signed-in desktop Orca, Narrator, NVDA or VoiceOver speech observations.
macOS AXAPI execution still requires a signed-in Aqua session with accessibility permission.
Real IME, drag/drop, Inspector, DPI/theme, clean-machine packaging, cross-application clipboard and one-hour soak remain operator platform checks.
